description: Japan's database of accident cases involving high-pressure gas, published by METI. The METI page gives the terms of use for the accident case database and its search macro: the FY2024 (Reiwa 6) edition was produced by the High Pressure Gas Safety Institute of Japan under a METI contract, copyright belongs to METI, use is allowed within copyright law but commercial use needs METI's consent, and passing the database to third parties or reposting it online is not allowed; METI accepts no liability, may update the database without notice, and answers questions only on its contents, with Microsoft Excel operation covered by the manual. The database is a free Excel download after accepting these terms; its number of cases and years are not stated on the page read. Coverage is Japan. Caveats: in Japanese, with redistribution prohibited. For simulation it gives accident records for gas production, storage and consumption sites, to set leak, fire and explosion frequencies in industrial and urban gas risk models. A related catalogue record is RISCAD.
